name: What type of drywall is best for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What type of drywall is best for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, moisture-resistant drywall, often called green board or cement board, is highly recommended. Green board has an additive that helps repel moisture, making it suitable for areas with moderate humidity. Cement board offers superior water resistance and durability, making it ideal for shower enclosures or areas directly exposed to water. While standard drywall can be used in less humid bathroom areas, moisture-resistant options provide better protection against mold and mildew, extending the life of your bathroom finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moisture-resistant drywall (green board) or cement board are best for bathrooms due to their resistance to humidity and water.
